title: Defeats the purpose...
text: Defeats the purpose.... We've given up on this, but it's also the type of item we don't feel good returning either, so we'll just keep it in the drawer. The problem is that it shoots out a tremendous amount of foam, so your soda tastes a little flat. That is why my headline says, "Defeats the purpose..." What good is saving all that carbon when you can't enjoy it? We followed their directions to dispense slowly, and to tilt and press the glass against the spout. It doesn't help, so I wonder... how slow do you have to go? It would be excruciatingly tedious to dispense at the speed of a sloth every time we want a glass. The search continues...

product_metadata.title: Sodafall Fizz Saver Soda bottle dispenser for seltzer/club soda and soda pop (grey)
features: Fizz keeper/Saves fizz - Saves money and time - Durable and easy to use - Has a fun retro design Package includes: - 1 Dispenser head - 2 plastic tubes - they can be cut into desirable size - 1 drip stopper - 1 rubber seal

Fizz keeper Dispensers fit and can be used on any plastic soda bottles.Different colors can be used for different designs and occasions.Great for parties and making cocktails. A must have home bar tool/accessory. Have fun with serving your favorite bubbly beverage! Perfect for making aperol spritz or old fashioned egg cream Visit our Instagram page for fun ideas: @sodafall.official

VERY IMPORTANT TO FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS for best results! Dispenser was designed and made for plain seltzer/club soda, so it works best with these. It also works with soda pops but they need to be highly carbonated!! Dispenser uses the pressure in the bottle to work, so if there is not enough carbonation=there is not enough pressure. It's physics! Carbonation in soda bottles can vary from bottle to bottle due to syrup content or proper/poor storage.
description: Introducing the Sodafall Fizz keeper Soda Dispenser - the ultimate solution for keeping your favorite carbonated soda drinks fizzy until the very last drop! No more wasting half-empty bottles of soda, seltzer or sparkling water due to lost carbonation. With our fizz keeper dispenser, you can enjoy a refreshing, bubbly beverage even weeks after opening the bottle. Plus, there's no need to buy expensive small soda cans and bottles anymore - simply use our dispenser with 2-liter bottles to save money. Our fizz saver dispensers are proudly made in Hungary, where soda water production has been a tradition since the 19th century. They are highly durable and built to last, so you can enjoy many years of perfectly carbonated drinks. However, it is essential to follow the instructions provided to ensure that your dispenser works correctly. We have found that many customers forget to remove the plastic ring that remains when they unscrew the bottle lid, leading them to think that the dispenser is not working correctly. At Sodafall, we stand behind the quality and reliability of our product. So, if you are looking for a hassle-free way to enjoy your favorite carbonated beverages without waste, try the Sodafall Soda Dispenser today! Whether you're using it with sparkling water, seltzer water, club soda, or even Coca-Cola, our dispenser guarantees a consistent and delightful carbonation experience. It's the ideal companion for making Aperol Spritz, adding that effervescent touch to your cocktails.
